title: Complexity Analysis
description: Master the language of efficiency. Learn how to measure and reason about algorithm performance.

topics.title: Why Complexity Matters
topics.description: Understand why analyzing algorithm efficiency is crucial before writing a single line of code.

topics.title: Time Complexity
topics.description: Learn to count operations and express how runtime grows with input size.

topics.title: Space Complexity
topics.description: Analyze how much memory an algorithm uses relative to input size.

topics.title: Big O Notation
topics.description: The standard notation for describing upper bounds on algorithm growth rates.

topics.title: Big Theta Notation
topics.description: Tight bounds that describe both the upper and lower limits of complexity.

topics.title: Big Omega Notation
topics.description: Lower bounds describing the best-case growth rate of an algorithm.

topics.title: Amortized Analysis
topics.description: Analyze the average cost per operation over a sequence of operations, not just the worst single case.

topics.title: Best Case Analysis
topics.description: Evaluate how an algorithm performs under the most favorable input conditions.

topics.title: Average Case Analysis
topics.description: Calculate expected performance across all possible inputs using probability.

topics.title: Worst Case Analysis
topics.description: Determine the maximum possible runtime for any valid input — the foundation of guarantees.

topics.title: Recurrence Relation
topics.description: Express the time complexity of recursive algorithms using mathematical recurrences.

topics.title: Master Theorem
topics.description: A powerful formula to solve common divide-and-conquer recurrences in one step.

title: Core Data Structures
description: Build your fundamental toolkit — the data structures every developer must know cold.

topics.title: Static Array
topics.description: Fixed-size contiguous memory blocks with O(1) random access.

topics.title: Dynamic Array
topics.description: Automatically resizing arrays that amortize the cost of growth over many insertions.

topics.title: Memory Layout
topics.description: How arrays are stored in memory and why cache locality matters for performance.

topics.title: Array Operations
topics.description: Master insertions, deletions, and searching with their complexity tradeoffs.

topics.title: Prefix Sum
topics.description: Precompute cumulative sums to answer range queries in O(1) time.

topics.title: Difference Array
topics.description: Apply range updates efficiently using the difference array technique.

topics.title: Kadane's Algorithm
topics.description: Find the maximum subarray sum in O(n) using dynamic programming.

topics.title: Moore Voting Algorithm
topics.description: Identify the majority element in O(n) time and O(1) space.

topics.title: Dutch National Flag
topics.description: Sort an array of three distinct values in a single pass — the 3-way partition technique.

topics.title: Majority Element
topics.description: Multiple approaches to find elements appearing more than n/2 times.

topics.title: String Basics
topics.description: Understand how strings are represented and manipulated in memory.

topics.title: Character Encoding
topics.description: The difference between ASCII and Unicode, and why encoding matters in systems.

topics.title: String Matching
topics.description: Naive and advanced approaches to find patterns within strings.

topics.title: Palindrome
topics.description: Detect palindromes using two-pointer and hashing techniques.

topics.title: Frequency Count
topics.description: Count character or element frequencies using hashmaps for fast lookups.

topics.title: Rolling Hash
topics.description: Efficiently compute substring hashes by sliding a window across a string.

topics.title: Singly Linked List
topics.description: One-directional chains of nodes with efficient insertions/deletions at the head.

topics.title: Doubly Linked List
topics.description: Bidirectional linked list enabling O(1) deletions given a node reference.

topics.title: Circular Linked List
topics.description: Linked list where the tail points back to the head, useful for cyclic buffers.

topics.title: Fast Slow Pointer
topics.description: Floyd's tortoise and hare technique for cycle detection in O(n) time.

topics.title: Reverse Linked List
topics.description: Iteratively and recursively reverse a singly linked list in O(n) time.

topics.title: Merge Linked Lists
topics.description: Merge two sorted linked lists into one sorted list efficiently.

topics.title: Cycle Detection
topics.description: Detect and find the start of cycles in a linked list using Floyd's algorithm.

topics.title: Stack Implementation
topics.description: Implement LIFO stacks using arrays or linked lists and understand their applications.

topics.title: Monotonic Stack
topics.description: Maintain a sorted stack to solve next-greater-element and histogram-type problems.

topics.title: Expression Evaluation
topics.description: Parse and evaluate arithmetic expressions using stacks.

topics.title: Parentheses Matching
topics.description: Validate balanced brackets using a stack in a single pass.

topics.title: Next Greater Element
topics.description: For each element, find the first greater element to its right using a monotonic stack.

topics.title: Histogram Problems
topics.description: Compute largest rectangles in histograms using the monotonic stack technique.

topics.title: Queue Implementation
topics.description: Implement FIFO queues and understand their role in BFS and scheduling.

topics.title: Circular Queue
topics.description: A ring buffer that reuses space efficiently without shifting elements.

topics.title: Deque (Double-Ended Queue)
topics.description: A queue supporting insertions and deletions at both ends.

topics.title: Priority Queue
topics.description: A queue that serves the highest-priority element first, backed by a heap.

topics.title: Monotonic Queue
topics.description: Maintain a sorted deque to answer sliding-window minimum/maximum queries.

topics.title: Hash Function
topics.description: Map keys to indices in a hash table using a deterministic function.

topics.title: Collision Handling
topics.description: Strategies for handling hash collisions: chaining vs open addressing.

topics.title: HashMap
topics.description: Key-value store with O(1) average lookup, insertion, and deletion.

topics.title: HashSet
topics.description: A set backed by a hash table for O(1) membership testing.

topics.title: Frequency Map
topics.description: A hashmap pattern for counting element occurrences — the backbone of many solutions.

title: Searching & Sorting
description: The bread and butter of every interview. Master how to find and arrange data efficiently.

topics.title: Linear Search
topics.description: Scan every element sequentially — the baseline search algorithm.

topics.title: Binary Search
topics.description: Halve the search space each step to find elements in O(log n) on sorted arrays.

topics.title: Lower Bound
topics.description: Find the first position where a value can be inserted to maintain sorted order.

topics.title: Upper Bound
topics.description: Find the last position where a value can be inserted to maintain sorted order.

topics.title: Binary Search on Answer
topics.description: Apply binary search on the answer space, not just on data — a powerful meta-pattern.

topics.title: Ternary Search
topics.description: Find the maximum or minimum of a unimodal function using divide-and-conquer.

topics.title: Bubble Sort
topics.description: Compare adjacent pairs and swap — simple but O(n²). Great for understanding swaps.

topics.title: Selection Sort
topics.description: Find the minimum each pass and place it — fewer swaps than bubble sort.

topics.title: Insertion Sort
topics.description: Build a sorted array element by element — efficient for nearly-sorted data.

topics.title: Merge Sort
topics.description: Divide, recursively sort, then merge — a stable O(n log n) algorithm.

topics.title: Quick Sort
topics.description: Partition around a pivot and recurse — O(n log n) average with O(1) extra space.

topics.title: Heap Sort
topics.description: Sort by repeatedly extracting the max from a max-heap — O(n log n) in-place.

topics.title: Counting Sort
topics.description: O(n + k) sorting for integers in a bounded range by counting occurrences.

topics.title: Radix Sort
topics.description: Sort digit by digit using a stable sort — O(nk) for k-digit numbers.

topics.title: Bucket Sort
topics.description: Distribute elements into buckets and sort each bucket — O(n) average for uniform data.

topics.title: Tim Sort
topics.description: Hybrid merge+insertion sort used in Python and Java — optimal for real-world data.

title: Trees
description: Hierarchical data structures powering databases, file systems, and every search optimization.

topics.title: Tree Traversal (DFS/BFS)
topics.description: Visit every node via inorder, preorder, postorder, and level-order traversals.

topics.title: Height & Diameter
topics.description: Compute tree height and the longest path between any two nodes.

topics.title: Boundary & Views
topics.description: Left view, right view, top view, bottom view — interview favorites.

topics.title: LCA (Lowest Common Ancestor)
topics.description: Find the deepest shared ancestor of two nodes efficiently.

topics.title: Tree Serialization
topics.description: Encode and decode a binary tree to/from a string — used in distributed systems.

topics.title: BST Insert, Delete, Search
topics.description: Core operations on Binary Search Trees with O(log n) average complexity.

topics.title: BST Validation
topics.description: Verify that a binary tree satisfies BST properties using range checks.

topics.title: Floor & Ceil in BST
topics.description: Find the greatest value ≤ key and smallest value ≥ key in a BST.

topics.title: Kth Smallest in BST
topics.description: Use inorder traversal to find the k-th smallest element in a BST.

topics.title: AVL Tree
topics.description: Self-balancing BST that maintains height ≤ O(log n) via rotations.

topics.title: Red-Black Tree
topics.description: Balanced BST with color properties — the basis for most language standard map implementations.

topics.title: B-Tree
topics.description: Multi-way balanced tree optimized for disk reads — used in databases and file systems.

topics.title: Max Heap
topics.description: Complete binary tree where every parent ≥ its children — O(log n) insert and extract.

topics.title: Min Heap
topics.description: Complete binary tree where every parent ≤ its children — powers priority queues.

topics.title: Heapify
topics.description: Build a heap from an unordered array in O(n) using bottom-up heapification.

topics.title: Median of Stream (Two Heaps)
topics.description: Maintain a running median using a max-heap and min-heap pair.

topics.title: Trie Prefix Search
topics.description: A tree of characters for O(L) string lookup — beats hashmaps for prefix queries.

topics.title: Autocomplete with Trie
topics.description: Suggest completions by traversing the trie from a prefix node.

topics.title: XOR Trie
topics.description: Binary trie used to maximize XOR between pairs — common in competitive programming.

title: Graphs
description: Model relationships. Graphs underpin social networks, navigation, scheduling, and the web.

topics.title: Graph Representation
topics.description: Adjacency list vs adjacency matrix — tradeoffs in space and query time.

topics.title: Directed, Undirected & Weighted Graphs
topics.description: Understand the three main types of graphs and when each applies.

topics.title: Graph BFS
topics.description: Breadth-first search to explore all nodes level by level — finds shortest paths in unweighted graphs.

topics.title: Graph DFS
topics.description: Depth-first search to explore as far as possible before backtracking.

topics.title: Connected Components
topics.description: Find all groups of connected nodes using DFS or Union-Find.

topics.title: Flood Fill
topics.description: BFS/DFS to fill connected regions — used in image processing and island counting.

topics.title: Multi-Source BFS
topics.description: Start BFS from multiple nodes simultaneously — efficient for distance-from-nearest problems.

topics.title: Dijkstra's Algorithm
topics.description: Find shortest paths from a source in a weighted graph using a greedy priority queue.

topics.title: Bellman-Ford Algorithm
topics.description: Shortest paths with negative weights — detects negative cycles.

topics.title: Floyd-Warshall Algorithm
topics.description: All-pairs shortest paths in O(V³) — compact DP on adjacency matrix.

topics.title: Prim's Algorithm
topics.description: Grow a minimum spanning tree greedily by adding the cheapest edge connecting the tree to a new node.

topics.title: Kruskal's Algorithm
topics.description: Build MST by sorting edges and adding them if they don't form a cycle — uses DSU.

topics.title: Disjoint Set Union (DSU)
topics.description: Union-Find with path compression and union by rank — O(α(n)) per operation.

topics.title: Topological Sort
topics.description: Order vertices of a DAG so every edge points forward — used in build systems and scheduling.

topics.title: Strongly Connected Components
topics.description: Find SCCs using Kosaraju's or Tarjan's algorithm — critical for condensation graphs.

topics.title: Bridges & Articulation Points
topics.description: Find edges and vertices whose removal disconnects the graph.

topics.title: Bipartite Check
topics.description: Determine if a graph can be 2-colored — equivalent to checking for odd cycles.

topics.title: Network Flow & Max Cut
topics.description: Model flow in networks — Ford-Fulkerson, Edmonds-Karp, and the max-flow min-cut theorem.

title: Recursion & Backtracking
description: Think in terms of subproblems. Backtracking lets you explore all possibilities and prune dead ends.

topics.title: Call Stack
topics.description: Understand how recursive calls are managed in the call stack and the risk of stack overflow.

topics.title: Recursive Tree
topics.description: Visualize recursive calls as a tree to analyze time complexity and space usage.

topics.title: Backtracking Basics
topics.description: Explore all possibilities by building incrementally and abandoning invalid paths.

topics.title: Subsets
topics.description: Generate all 2^n subsets of a set using bit manipulation or recursive backtracking.

topics.title: Permutations
topics.description: Generate all n! arrangements of elements using backtracking with swaps.

topics.title: N-Queens Problem
topics.description: Place N queens on an N×N chessboard so no two attack each other.

topics.title: Sudoku Solver
topics.description: Fill a 9×9 grid satisfying row, column, and box constraints using backtracking.

topics.title: Rat in a Maze
topics.description: Find paths from start to end in a grid — classic backtracking DFS problem.

topics.title: Word Search
topics.description: Search for a word in a 2D character grid using DFS with backtracking.

title: Greedy Algorithms
description: Make the locally optimal choice at each step to achieve the globally optimal solution.

topics.title: Greedy Strategy
topics.description: Learn when greedy works, why it fails, and how to prove greedy correctness.

topics.title: Interval Scheduling
topics.description: Maximize the number of non-overlapping events — the canonical greedy problem.

topics.title: Huffman Coding
topics.description: Build an optimal prefix-free code using a priority queue — the basis of data compression.

topics.title: Fractional Knapsack
topics.description: Maximize value by taking fractions of items greedily by value/weight ratio.

topics.title: Job Scheduling
topics.description: Schedule jobs with deadlines and profits to maximize total gain.

topics.title: Activity Selection
topics.description: Select maximum non-conflicting activities — the foundational interval greedy problem.

topics.title: Merge Intervals
topics.description: Collapse overlapping intervals into a minimal set — an interview and systems classic.

title: Divide & Conquer
description: Break problems into independent subproblems, solve them, and combine the results.

topics.title: Binary Search (D&C view)
topics.description: Binary search as a canonical divide-and-conquer algorithm.

topics.title: Merge Sort (D&C)
topics.description: Recursively split and merge — the archetypal divide-and-conquer sorting algorithm.

topics.title: Quick Sort (D&C)
topics.description: Partition-based sorting using randomized pivots for average O(n log n).

topics.title: Closest Pair of Points
topics.description: Find the two nearest points in O(n log n) using divide-and-conquer.

topics.title: Inversion Count
topics.description: Count pairs where a[i] > a[j] with i < j by modifying merge sort.

title: Dynamic Programming
description: Solve complex problems by breaking them into overlapping subproblems and memoizing results.

topics.title: Memoization (Top-Down DP)
topics.description: Cache recursive call results to avoid redundant computation.

topics.title: Tabulation (Bottom-Up DP)
topics.description: Fill a DP table iteratively from base cases to the final answer.

topics.title: State Design
topics.description: Learn to identify what information must be tracked to define a DP state uniquely.

topics.title: State Transition
topics.description: Express how the optimal substructure relates states to build up to the solution.

topics.title: Fibonacci (DP foundation)
topics.description: The simplest DP — from exponential recursion to O(n) with memoization.

topics.title: 0/1 Knapsack
topics.description: Classic DP: maximize value under a weight constraint by including or excluding items.

topics.title: Longest Increasing Subsequence (LIS)
topics.description: Find the longest subsequence where each element is strictly greater than the previous.

topics.title: Longest Common Subsequence (LCS)
topics.description: Find the longest subsequence present in both strings — O(mn) classic DP.

topics.title: Edit Distance (Levenshtein)
topics.description: Minimum insertions, deletions, and substitutions to transform one string into another.

topics.title: Matrix Chain Multiplication
topics.description: Find the optimal parenthesization to minimize scalar multiplications.

topics.title: Partition DP
topics.description: Partition a sequence into optimal parts — used in palindrome partitioning and burst balloons.

topics.title: Digit DP
topics.description: Count numbers in a range satisfying digit-based constraints using DP on digits.

topics.title: Tree DP
topics.description: Run DP on tree structures to solve subtree problems, rerooting, and diameter queries.

topics.title: Bitmask DP
topics.description: Use bitmasks to represent subsets as DP states — exponential but powerful.

topics.title: Interval DP
topics.description: Solve problems on intervals of a sequence — used in optimal BST and matrix chain problems.

title: Advanced Algorithms
description: The algorithms that separate good engineers from exceptional ones. Used in top-tier interviews.

topics.title: Sliding Window
topics.description: Maintain a window over data and expand/shrink it to answer range queries efficiently.

topics.title: Two Pointer
topics.description: Use two indices moving toward each other or in the same direction to avoid nested loops.

topics.title: Prefix Sum (Advanced)
topics.description: Extend prefix sums to 2D grids, XOR prefix sums, and modular arithmetic problems.

topics.title: Sweep Line
topics.description: Scan from left to right processing events — used in interval union, skyline, and area queries.

topics.title: Meet in the Middle
topics.description: Split a problem into two halves, enumerate both, then combine — O(2^(n/2)) instead of O(2^n).

topics.title: Segment Tree
topics.description: Range queries (min, max, sum) and point updates in O(log n) on a static array.

topics.title: Fenwick Tree (BIT)
topics.description: Simpler O(log n) prefix sums and point updates with a beautiful binary trick.

topics.title: Lazy Propagation
topics.description: Extend segment trees to support O(log n) range updates by deferring updates.

topics.title: KMP String Search
topics.description: Knuth-Morris-Pratt: find a pattern in text in O(n+m) using a failure function.

topics.title: Rabin-Karp
topics.description: Rolling hash for O(n+m) average string search — extensible to multiple patterns.

topics.title: Z-Algorithm
topics.description: Compute Z-array in O(n) for powerful string matching and pattern finding.

topics.title: Manacher's Algorithm
topics.description: Find all palindromic substrings in O(n) — the champion of palindrome problems.

topics.title: Suffix Array
topics.description: Sort all suffixes of a string and use LCP array for powerful string operations.

title: Advanced Data Structures
description: Specialized structures built for performance at scale — used in databases, file systems, and search engines.

topics.title: Interval Tree
topics.description: Query all intervals overlapping a point or range in O(log n + k).

topics.title: Order Statistic Tree
topics.description: Augmented BST supporting rank and select queries in O(log n).

topics.title: Bloom Filter
topics.description: Space-efficient probabilistic structure for set membership — used in databases and CDNs.

topics.title: Skip List
topics.description: Probabilistic layered linked list supporting O(log n) search — an alternative to balanced BSTs.

topics.title: LSM Tree
topics.description: Log-Structured Merge-Tree — optimized for write-heavy workloads, used in LevelDB and Cassandra.

topics.title: Quad Tree
topics.description: Partition 2D space recursively — used in spatial indexing and collision detection.

topics.title: K-D Tree
topics.description: Binary tree for k-dimensional points enabling nearest-neighbor search in O(log n).

title: DSA Patterns
description: Recognize the 17 universal patterns that cover 90%+ of interview problems.

topics.title: Two Pointer Pattern
topics.description: Recognize when two indices can replace O(n²) nested loops.

topics.title: Sliding Window Pattern
topics.description: Identify when a window of variable or fixed size eliminates brute force.

topics.title: Fast & Slow Pointer Pattern
topics.description: Detect cycles, find midpoints, and more using two pointers at different speeds.

topics.title: Merge Interval Pattern
topics.description: Collapse, insert, or intersect intervals by sorting and scanning once.

topics.title: Cyclic Sort Pattern
topics.description: Place elements at their correct index in O(n) — powerful for 1-to-n problems.

topics.title: Binary Search Pattern
topics.description: Apply binary search beyond sorted arrays: on answer, on rotation, on conditions.

topics.title: DFS Pattern
topics.description: Template for tree/graph DFS, path tracking, and backtracking problems.

topics.title: BFS Pattern
topics.description: Template for level-order traversal, shortest unweighted path, and multi-source spread.

topics.title: Topological Sort Pattern
topics.description: Identify dependency-ordering problems solvable by Kahn's algorithm or DFS.

topics.title: Heap Pattern (Top K)
topics.description: Use heaps for streaming top-K, kth largest, and running median problems.

topics.title: Prefix Sum Pattern
topics.description: Identify subarray sum problems solvable in O(n) using prefix sums and hashmaps.

topics.title: Monotonic Stack Pattern
topics.description: Recognize NGE, span, and histogram-style problems that need a monotonic stack.

topics.title: Monotonic Queue Pattern
topics.description: Sliding window min/max in O(n) using a deque.

topics.title: DP Pattern Recognition
topics.description: Identify overlapping subproblems and optimal substructure to choose the right DP approach.

topics.title: Backtracking Pattern
topics.description: Template for exhaustive search with constraint pruning.

topics.title: Trie Pattern
topics.description: Recognize prefix-matching, autocomplete, and XOR-max problems requiring a trie.

topics.title: Union-Find Pattern
topics.description: Detect connectivity, cycles, and component merging with DSU.

title: Interview Preparation
description: Crack top-tier tech interviews. Learn to think, communicate, and optimize like a senior engineer.

topics.title: Brute Force First
topics.description: Always start with the brute force — it proves correctness and gives you something to optimize.

topics.title: Pattern Recognition
topics.description: Train your eye to classify new problems into the 17 meta-patterns within seconds.

topics.title: Optimization Strategies
topics.description: Techniques to move from O(n²) to O(n log n) to O(n) — the interviewer's favorite journey.

topics.title: Dry Run Technique
topics.description: Trace through your code on small examples to catch bugs before you run it.

topics.title: Edge Cases
topics.description: Systematically enumerate empty inputs, single elements, duplicates, and extremes.

topics.title: Complexity Analysis in Interviews
topics.description: Explain time and space complexity clearly and derive it live for your solution.

topics.title: Communication Skills
topics.description: Structure your thinking out loud — interviewers evaluate process, not just answers.

topics.title: Mock Interview Strategy
topics.description: How to practice mock interviews effectively to simulate real pressure.
